items.html: And the matter is that these seven kings are the Gevurot that emerged in the world first, as the verse says, “In the beginning Elokim created,” and afterwards He joined the measure of mercy with it, “on the day that HaVaYaH Elokim made,” so that the world could endure and not revert to Tohu VaVohu [chaos and void], as it is written, “And the earth was Tohu VaVohu,” after it says, “In the beginning Elokim created,” which are the seven kings. And corresponding to them are the seven words in the verse of Beresheet. And the name HaVaYaH is the Hassadim, and it is the eighth king, called Hadar, which is the upper Hesed, as mentioned in the Idra; and it is the name MA, as is known, for the name MA is in the Hassadim and the name BON is in the Gevurot. And they are all hard and mighty judgments, from whose dross the shells emerged, and this was through their death and their fall, in the secret of the dust of the upper earth — “the dust that shall be on the floor of the Tabernacle,” which is the world of Beria; and there they were sorted, like a man in the grave, as above, for Beria, which is beneath the Tabernacle, is Malchut of Atzilut. And there those mighty sparks were cast, as written in Parashat Pekudei as mentioned: “He casts sparks to every side and sorts the waste from within thought,” etc. Thus the casting of these sparks below into Beria is in order to sort the waste and the shells that were in potential in the upper thought, and now they came out into actuality. And just as the sparks that a craftsman strikes out of iron are extinguished at once, so these sparks were extinguished and died and returned to the dust, and then they were sorted. And as will be written, God willing.
